subject: chem
title: An Introduction to AS Level Organic Chemistry
subtitle: An Introduction to AS Level Organic Chemistry with core theory, reaction logic, and exam-focused application.
concept: Organic chemistry focuses on carbon compounds and predictable patterns of functional group behavior. The functional group is the most useful feature for predicting reaction type.
Homologous series share general formulae and similar chemistry because they keep the same functional group while chain length changes physical properties gradually.
At AS level, success depends on identifying what changes and what stays the same in each transformation: bonds broken, bonds formed, reagents, and conditions.
